Frequently Asked Questions.

Common Questions
About AI SEO Services

What is the difference between SEO and AEO?

Traditional SEO focuses on ranking web pages on a list of search results. Answer Engine Optimization (AEO) focuses on getting your brand cited as the direct answer in tools like ChatGPT, Perplexity, and Google AI Overviews.

Do I still need traditional Google SEO?

Absolutely. AI models still rely on traditional search indexes and authority metrics to determine which sources are trustworthy. Our approach secures your standard Google rankings while preparing you for AI-driven search.

What does the free AI visibility audit include?

We manually test your brand's presence across major LLMs, check your technical schema foundation, and review your semantic content clusters to see if generative engines are actively pulling your data.

How does a /llms.txt file help?

It acts as a direct, markdown-formatted map for AI crawlers, making it incredibly easy for them to read and digest your core brand information, documentation, and offerings without scraping messy HTML.
